description: L4 planner: optional /candidate override of the module root, wipe the module pool, emit l4diff.json (sealed base × candidate), list the artifacts, write pool/l1 and pool/l2, and orchestrate L2 → L1 → L2 by type:agent steps in the same task. No LLM. Does not read ontology to opine. Never add-message-ai from a step.
principles: Sequence is declared in this file via dependsOn and done-anchors. Steps do not enqueue their successor by name.
Deterministic first: the L4 planner never calls an LLM. It lists artifacts; it does not read ontology to opine.
A step declared here and not implemented stops the run naming that step.
Pipeline state of the module lives on disk at l4/{module}/pipeline/pipeline.json. The planner records l5Adjusted there; it does not own the NS5 status.
Each owner traces only on its own pipeline.json (L4 on l4, L2 on l2). One file, one writer.
workspaceDependencies of the current project's l5/config.json must list 102020 and 102021 so the platform finds the planners by name. Missing ids are appended at the end.

On accept, entry10 wipes l4/<mod>/pool/{l1,l2,l4}/ (messages and web/*.json). The pool is derived from l4 — if l4 changed, planning is redone, including an implement message left unconsumed by a prior accept (a new plan invalidates an old accept, regardless of mode).

dispatch20 writes the two pool messages, tagged mode: estimate, then creates the L2 r1 type:agent step in the same task. loop30 creates L1 r1 with the real l2→l1 file when that message is in the box (dependsOn of an agent step waits for scheduling, not the artifact), then L2 effort r1 with the real l1→l2 file. Further rounds only when a new message with round>1 is in the box, up to 3. Round 3 with a non-empty box is disputed.

loop30 also drains pool/l4, the mailbox L4 itself owns: L2's l2→l4 effort-ready report is traced processed and deleted below round 3; at round 3 it is traced disputed and kept, so the newRelease review run reads that outcome the same way it already does for l1/l2. 'Defined' is l1 and l2 with no fresh work and pool/l4 with no pendency.

A missing planner is a readable status (L2/L1 not available). A failed planner step fails the task with the step name. A completed planner that produced no output fails the task with '<planId> ran without output'. There is no /rebuild. This flow never writes mode: implement — that is the newRelease accept, once the run is ready.
Deterministic user text is English. Internal messages stay English literals.

invocation.moduleRule: The module name is the first lowerCamel token. The module must already exist in l4/. Canonical and manual roots require pipeline.status complete. A sealed revision root is gated by the revision manifest, not pipeline.status.
invocation.candidateRule: /candidate alone points moduleFolder at <mod>/tobe/plan (manual root: revision is null; base is the sealed catalog, else canonical). /candidate pipeline/changes/<changeId>/revisions/<revisionId>/l4 is a sealed revision: entry requires readL4Revision, refuses a missing pipeline/releases/<baseId>/l4, and records revision on pipeline.json and both l4diff.json. The diff base is that release and never falls back to canonical. Without the flag the canonical l4 is unchanged.
invocation.estimateRule: /estimate as an invocation flag is refused ('not available yet') — there is nothing to opt into: dispatch20 and loop30 already tag every pool message mode: estimate, the only mode this planning loop reads or writes. mode: implement is written elsewhere, by the newRelease accept once a run is ready.
invocation.rebuildRule: There is no /rebuild. This flow does not create or wipe a module.

steps.goal: Parse the invocation including /candidate, setModuleRoot, refuse deterministically, wipe the module pool (messages + web/*.json, poolWiped on the pipeline) — including an implement message left unconsumed by a prior accept, since a new plan invalidates an old accept regardless of mode — append planner projects to l5/config.json when missing, record l5Adjusted on the module pipeline. A sealed revision root skips pipeline.status and requires a manifest that matches its copies; a missing release folder is refused by name. On any /candidate root, write revision (null when manual) on pipeline.json. Unknown pipeline flowId is recorded, not refused.

Diff the base l4 against the /candidate root by artifact and write pool/l1/web/l4diff.json and pool/l2/web/l4diff.json. On a sealed revision the base is pipeline/releases/<manifest.baseId>/l4 and never canonical. Otherwise the sealed catalog, then canonical, then empty. revision is the verified identity, or null off a sealed revision. No candidate ⇒ items: [] and revision: null.

List l4 artifacts (excluding pipeline/, tobe/, pool/), cite pool/*/web/l4diff.json, write the two pool messages tagged mode: estimate, record delivered, create the L2 r1 type:agent step. Prompt is {moduleName, thread, file, candidate}. L1 r1 is created by loop30 when the l2→l1 message exists.

After L2 r1, create L1 r1 with the real l2→l1 filename when that message is in the box, then L2 effort r1 with the real l1→l2 filename. A completed planner without output fails the task. Further rounds only when a new message with round>1 is in the box, up to 3 (disputed at 3). Also drains pool/l4 every tick: the l2→l4 effort-ready report is processed and deleted below round 3, disputed and kept at round 3. Write {round, l2, l1, effort} on the l4 pipeline and complete.
